title: Discharge of sewage and discharge and/or management of stormwater runoff.
officialText:
Applications for construction document approval shall comply with Sections 107.11.1, 107.11.2 and 107.11.3.
*Section 107.11 was amended by: Local Law 97 of 2017. This law has an effective date of June 1, 2019.
